summary: Three qualifying stabilized Retail sales comps in Raleigh were identified within 1.26 miles and the 2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31 window: R4105 ($400/sf), R8422 (updated to $16.74M; $432.56/sf), and R3397 ($400/sf). Several 2026 sales were excluded due to executed amendments reclassifying them to Office, redevelopment status, minority interest, related-party, portfolio pricing, listing status, distance beyond 8 miles, non-sf size units, missing consideration, or publication after the cutoff. A duplicate second-source record (R3577) was noted but not selected.
limitations: Relies solely on provided S-/U- extracts; later-dated updates (e.g., U-R3397-2 on 2026-09-10) were not considered.
Distances are as provided and assumed comparable; no site-level verification.
Price per sf rounded to two decimals; minor rounding differences may exist.
No additional tenancy, NOI, or cap-rate context was available to further screen comparability.
